title: Playback Planner Transcode Seam Deepening
problem: PlaybackTargetProfile still constructs execution-ready TranscodeProfile values, which leaks transcode execution vocabulary into the playback planner just before HLS seek, HDR, downmix, and resource scheduling work deepen the media engine.

evidence.summary: Opened the playback planner/transcode seam lane, scoped it to behavior-preserving profile-builder ownership migration, and linked the workstream from playback architecture indexes.
Moved remux/HLS playback profile construction to transcode-owned builders and removed PlaybackTargetProfile methods that built TranscodeProfile values.
Updated playback app remux/HLS composition and server test identity helpers to call transcode-owned profile builders while preserving focused playback behavior.
Closed the lane with focused nextest gates, final formatting/diff checks, JSON validation, and follow-on media features left as separate lanes.

continue_policy.notes: Closed on 2026-05-29 after behavior-preserving profile-builder ownership migration. Continue with separate feature lanes for HLS seek, HDR, downmix, subtitle burn-in, or resource scheduling.
